name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in the intricate world of engineering. A fascination with vehicle dynamics led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he quickly gravitated towards motorsports applications. His meticulous approach and innovative ideas caught the eye of several racing teams. After a brief stint as a race engineer, he quickly moved up the management ranks.

Marko's strength lies in his ability to inspire his team to push the boundaries of performance. He believes that a strong team dynamic, combined with cutting-edge technology, is the key to success in the fiercely competitive world of motorsport. His perfectionist tendencies are balanced by his ambitious drive to succeed, making him a formidable leader.

His relative youth belies his experience, having already contributed to championship-winning efforts. His vision for the future of Tickford Racing is built on fostering innovation and developing talent, aiming to establish a legacy of excellence within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze, Marko projects an air of quiet intensity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workstation.
